meta.name: subagent-review
meta.description: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency using three parallel disposable subagents. This skill should be used when the user says "review", "simplify", "code review", or wants a one-shot code review without persistent reviewers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审查代码，提升复用与质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在合并前快速获得代码质量与复用性的自动审查。
copy.tagline_en: Review code in parallel to boost reuse and quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast automated code review before merging.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会审查所有变更代码，检查代码复用、质量和效率，发现并修复问题，最后总结。
howto.when: 当你说“review”、“simplify”、“code review”或要求一次性代码审查时触发。

say.text: 请审查当前分支的代码变更。
帮我简化这段代码，提高效率。
say.note: Claude 会重点检查效率和冗余。

say.text: 检查代码重用性和质量问题。
say.note: Claude 会并行审查并修复问题。

howto.what_en: After installed, Claude will review all changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, fix issues found, and summarize.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "review", "simplify", "code review", or request a one-shot code review.

say_en.text: Review the code changes in the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff and launch three review agents.

say_en.text: Simplify this code and improve its efficiency.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on efficiency and redundancy.
Claude will parallel review and fix issues.
